messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning host swap for the Architecture Review Board next 6 weeks. I put a draft prep packet here: https://docs.internal/redwood/arb/prep-packet — can folks volunteer to host or co-host? Looking to keep meetings 45m, focused reviews + 10m standards Q&A.

mira: I can take the slot for week of May 12 if that helps. happy to shepherd the RFC queue beforehand. @alex please add me to the doc. :thumbsup:

samir: +1 for Mira. question: do we want to keep weekly cadence or go biweekly? traffic's been light last month.

alex: leaning biweekly unless there's a backlog — fewer context switches. propose biweekly for June and revisit. Anyone opposed?

jia: biweekly works. can we add 'E2E test infra RFC' to the agenda for Jun 2? it's timeboxed to 15m for design + rollout constraints.

alex: added. agenda snippet I dropped into the doc:```
1) Quick triage (5m) - outstanding blockers from last ARB
2) RFC review (15m) - E2E test infra (author: jia)
3) Design review (15m) - model routing fallback logic (owner: samir)
4) Standards & takeaways (10m) - logging/trace expectations
```

mira: can we also include a short 'acceptance criteria' checklist for RFCs? we've had a few that lacked rollout plans. I can add a template.

samir: agree on the checklist. maybe 1 pager: testing, metrics, rollback plan, perf targets.

alex: @mira that'd be great. also thinking of rotating hosts in pairs so onboarding is lighter. host pairs: (alex+mira), (samir+jia), then repeat. thoughts?

jia: pairs sound good — overlap helps continuity. I'm fine with samir as co-host for first round.

mira: works for me. i'll draft the checklist and put it under 'prep' in the packet.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: ARB — Jun 2 10:00-10:45 PT (biweekly) — Hosts: samir, jia. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/arb-jun2. Added guests: eng-platform, eng-runtime.

alex: thanks bot. @samir can you queue up the model routing PR and make sure diff includes perf bench notes? just 5 bullets in the PR description is fine.

samir: will do. I'll add perf numbers and an 'if X then fallback Y' matrix.

jia: for the E2E RFC I'll upload diagrams and a short rollout playbook by Mon. can someone review doc structure?

mira: i'll take a pass on doc structure Thu afternoon.

alex: awesome. final ask — if you want an item added, post to this thread by EOD Wed so we can freeze agenda and notify reviewers. otherwise we'll assume current packet is final. :calendar:

mira: noted. tagging a couple of reviewers in the doc now.

samir: thanks all. see you Jun 2.

alex: cheers, and thanks for the quick responses. :rocket:
